title: Design Studio Selections Training Note: Cure Rate After a Prompt Replacement Payment
content:
**Q. Does a prompt replacement payment lower the returned payment fee on a Design Studio Selections file?**
Yes. The cure rate is set by the most recent option deposit payment posted on the file, counted in calendar days from the date of the return:

- an ACH or wire payment posted on the return date or up to 3 days after it brings the cure rate to 50 percent;
- a check or card payment posted on the return date or up to 3 days after it brings it to 75 percent;
- otherwise the cure rate is 100 percent.

**Q. Which records are read?**
The latest option deposit payment entry on the design ledger, with its payment method and posting date, and the date of the return on the returned-payment entry.

**Q. Where are the edges?** (hypothetical return dated 2026-07-10)

| Most recent payment | Method | Cure rate |
|---|---|---|
| Posted 2026-07-10 | Wire | 50 percent |
| Posted 2026-07-13 | ACH | 50 percent |
| Posted 2026-07-13 | Check | 75 percent |
| Posted 2026-07-14 | ACH | 100 percent |
| The returned payment itself, posted before the return | Any | 100 percent |
